title: Privacy and Data Protection
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Privacy and Data Protection.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Privacy and Data Protection topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.

overview_visual.alt_text: Four-stage overview for Module 24, Privacy and Data Protection.
overview_visual.caption: Overview of Module 24. This visual supports the syllabus; individual lessons remain listed below.

notes: Preserves 5 main lesson(s) from the source PDF. Collect only data needed for a documented purpose, restrict access, avoid sensitive values in URLs/logs, set retention/deletion rules, and verify the complete data lifecycle. Use authorized local labs and synthetic data only.
